description.text: Featured advantages 1. "First-class undergraduate professional construction point" in Hubei Province 2. "Excellent Grassroots Teaching Organization" in Hubei Province 3. "The first batch of key cultivation undergraduate majors" of similar universities in Hubei Province 4. Hubei Province's "first-class courses" and "high-quality video open courses", excellent cases of industry-university-research projects of the Ministry of Education 5. Wuhan University professors lecture, "Hubei famous teachers", "Wuhan Yellow Crane talents", "doctoral workstation" team Cultivation goals Cultivate high-quality application-oriented professionals who systematically master the basic knowledge, basic theories and basic skills of civil engineering, and can engage in construction technology management and project supervision in civil engineering fields such as housing construction, roads and bridges, and intelligent construction. Core courses Building materials, material mechanics, structural mechanics, BIM modeling and drawing (Revit), architectural CAD, building construction technology, building construction organization and management, BIM5D and construction enterprise informatization, intelligent building, prefabricated building, reinforced concrete structure, masonry structure, steel structure, seismic resistance of building structure, foundation engineering, foundation treatment, building structure PKPM, etc.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Wuchang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Colored scanned copy of passport which is valid for at least one year2. White background colored bareheaded digital photo in Passport size(The head takes up 2/3 of the size of the photo; the photo pixel is no less than 320*240, the aspect ratio is 4:3, the size is 100-500kb, JPG format)3. The colored scanned copy of the original diploma of secondary high school and above (If it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.)4. The colored scanned copy of the original transcript of secondary high school and above (If it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.)5. Educational background and working experience detailed from primary school to the date of application6. Transfer letter with attendance record for applicants with studying experience in China7. Fixed deposit certificate with minimum US $30008. Medical report9. None criminal record

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy. Non-Chinese citizens of secondary high school graduates, holding valid foreign passports in good health and with good character.
